name: Heritage
summary: The 2026 site, cleaned up: banner, left menu, page, right menu. Laptops stack both menus on the left; phones get a Menu button.

name: Masthead
summary: Closest to sigmod.org: one menu bar with dropdowns, a 2024-style information bar under the banner, and the current section's pages on the left of every page.

name: Handbook
summary: Like conference documentation: one sidebar with all eight groups as folding lists and a filter box, plus an 'On this page' list and previous/next links.

name: Landing
summary: The homepage leads with when, where and the next deadlines, then every page grouped in cards. Inner pages show their group's pages as buttons.

name: Atlas
summary: One menu bar that opens the whole 2026 site map at once, an index page for each of the eight sections, and an 'On this page' list on long pages.
